welcome.text:
**Welcome to TradeZoro** 👋
A friendly place to learn trading together. Please read the rules, then pick your roles.

**Rules**
1. Be kind and respectful. No harassment, hate or personal attacks.
2. No spam, self-promo or shilling. No invite links to other servers.
3. No selling signals, paid groups or services, and no DMs to sell anything.
4. No profit claims and no P&L screenshots. Share lessons, not results.
5. Never share passwords, keys or personal data. Staff will never ask for them.
6. Use the right channel and keep it on topic.

**Education only. Not financial advice.** Trading involves risk of loss.
Need help? Ask in #help-and-support.

howto.text:
**How to use TradeZoro** → https://tradezoro.com
• **ZoroAcademy**: 64 written chapters on ICT and SMT, plus trading models.
• **ZoroCharts**: charts, indicators, drawings, alerts and paper trading.
• **Replay One**: practise on past data, one bar at a time.
• **JournalX**: log and review your trades.
• **GEX+** and order flow tools are part of **TradeZoro Pro**.
• Also: Market Stats, scanner, Global Monitor, economic calendar and the Trading Floor.

Questions? #help-and-support. Ideas? #feature-requests.
Education only. Not financial advice.
